Given The author sent version 0.5.0. The sponsor is not available for a week.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: When The author asks who else can approve the version.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then Version 0.5.0 has no approval until the sponsor decides, and every export of it shows "Draft".
